proposal.description: JCM1270 explicitly weighs44g BD-Difco Columbia blood agar base, then separately adds water and sheep blood. It directs suspension of44g powder in1L purified water. Those are manufacturer preparation/formula statements, not dry-product mass fractions, final yield, or an identified historical JCM lot. The same page separately gives BBL42.5g (including13.5g agar, meat peptic digest and heart pancreatic digest) and DifcoEH39g (including12g agar and different nutrient inputs).
